scripts.dev: corepack pnpm build:packages && corepack pnpm -r --parallel --stream --if-present dev
scripts.lint: corepack pnpm build:packages && corepack pnpm -r --workspace-concurrency=2 --if-present lint
scripts.test: corepack pnpm build:packages && corepack pnpm -r --workspace-concurrency=2 --if-present test
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm build:packages && corepack pnpm -r --workspace-concurrency=2 --if-present typecheck
scripts.validate: corepack pnpm format:check && corepack pnpm lint && corepack pnpm typecheck && corepack pnpm test && corepack pnpm build
